text.tspan: Calculate every tax line on a paycheck with one request. You’re in test
mode, and the first 14 days are free.
Your test key starts with sk_test_ and was shown once at sign-up. You
can create a new one from your account at any time.
POST a paycheck to /v1/paycheck. The example on the right works as-is
Each entry in result.taxes[] names the tax, who pays it, its jurisdiction, the
taxable wages and the amount, with a detail explaining the math.
Send your secret key as a Bearer token in the Authorization header of every request.
Keep keys on your server, never in a browser or mobile app.
Test key. Same API, same results. For building and your trial.
Live key. Metered and billed at $0.125 per paycheck.
Calculate one paycheck and get back every tax line that applies.
Pay date, YYYY-MM-DD. Selects the rules in effect
How often this employee is paid.
One entry per earning on the check.
Where the work happens, plus that state’s
certificate (e.g. workCity). Omit for federal only.
Where the employee lives, when it differs from
Employer facts some rules need, such as a state
Which employment-tax rules apply. Defaults to
Hours in this pay period, for minimum-wage checks.
Round federal withholding to whole dollars. Defaults

is never returned as a silent zero.
